title: The war table shows the continent
changes: The war table is now a map of the whole continent: the lands lie round the Crown of the Marches, with each clan's banner standing in its homeland.
Territories keep their places inside their land, tinted by whoever holds them, with ember front lines where two clans meet and dashed ways between the lands.
Hover a territory on the war table to see who holds it, its level and its Control.
